predecessors.name: Japan (Empire of Japan, 1868-1947)
predecessors.text: the northern half of Korea: 'The SCA governed the northern half of Korea'; Cliopatria's 1948 outline of the DPRK is the best match

successors.name: Democratic People's Republic of Korea
successors.text: the northern half of Korea: 'The SCA governed the northern half of Korea'; Cliopatria's 1948 outline of the DPRK is the best match

ledger.x: 24 August 1945: the Soviet Civil Administration is formed in the north.
February 1946: the Soviet administration hands day-to-day government to the Provisional People's Committee for North Korea.
9 September 1948: the DPRK replaces the Soviet administration.

certainty.note: The line of the Soviet zone is the 38th parallel (not on the page).
